test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**frowk**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**frowk**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**frock**'.
 
• It means 'a dress'. (एक पोशाक, फ़्रॉक)
 
 
• *Example: a party **frock**...*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other words:

 
 
• **frown**: to show** **you are angry, serious, etc. by making lines appear on your forehead above your nose. (ऐसे क्रोध प्रदर्शित करना कि माथे पर रेखाएँ दिखाई देने लगें; भौंहें तन जाना, त्‍योरी चढ़ना)
 
• **front**: the side or surface of something/somebody that faces forward. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का सामने दिखने वाला हिस्‍सा)
 
• **frost**: the weather condition when the temperature falls below 0° Celsius (freezing point) and a thin layer of ice forms on the ground and other surfaces, especially at night. [हिमांक से नीचे के तापमान वाला मौसम जिसमें (विशेषतः रात के समय) ज़मीन पर बर्फ़ की हलकी परत जम जाती है; ठंढ]
